summary_en: Hibiya Engineering authorized acquisition of up to 300,000 shares (0.72% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥1.1 billion through market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 from November 12, 2026 to March 31, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder value under the Ninth Medium-Term Management Plan.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Hibiya Engineering's board of directors authorized a new share repurchase program following the completion of a previous ToSTNeT-3 acquisition that ended on May 13, 2026. The company will acquire up to 300,000 ordinary shares, representing 0.72% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum aggregate price of ¥1.1 billion. The acquisition period runs from November 12, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The repurchase will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including off-hours block trades via ToSTNeT-3. At the authorization date, the company held 2,542,300 treasury shares against 41,457,700 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock). The company undertakes this program to enhance capital efficiency and achieve sustained growth in shareholder value in accordance with its Ninth Medium-Term Management Plan shareholder return policy.
